correctness.rationale: Equilibrium renewal residual transform equals (1-phi(s))/(tau s); alternating renewal gives C-hat(s)=1/s-2(1-phi)/(tau s^2(1+phi)). The harmonic filter yields V=v^2 C-hat(k)/k. Strict Jensen for e^-kL proves unique constant-duration minimizer; a positive two-point rare-long family tends to the upper envelope, and convex order forces monotonicity. Taking k->infty twice recovers v,tau and then the complete phi, giving law by uniqueness of Laplace transforms. k->0 finite-variance expansion gives inverse-k constant, while uniform phase for deterministic duration gives uniform limiting X and variance v^2 tau^2/12. Independent telegraph and alternative reward checks passed sampled cases.
